selection: Curated works, grouped by theme; not an exhaustive ranking. Related book chapters and manuals are represented by the SpecC book rather than listed separately.

themes.title: EDA
themes.description: Design automation must make a growing space of hardware choices tractable. These works connect executable specifications to implementation, and reformulate synthesis and placement so that better designs remain practical to compute.

themes.title: Representational Combinatorics
themes.description: The cost of a combinatorial problem depends on how its possibilities are represented. By encoding sets and relations in decision diagrams, these works exploit shared structure to analyze programs and explore circuit choices without enumerating every case.

themes.title: Performance Analysis
themes.description: A useful performance model explains how workload behavior becomes a hardware cost. These works preserve the statistics that matter—signal correlation and uneven write activity—to expose tradeoffs in numerical precision and storage endurance.

themes.title: Custom Computing
themes.description: Specialization pays when the organization of hardware matches the structure of the work. These projects examine where data moves, where state lives, and when computation advances—and how to preserve a custom design as its implementation technology changes.
